thesis: HAS is a post-earnings trend continuation with fundamentals that back the move. Q3 revenue grew about 15% and net income about 69%, and the 2026 outlook was raised. Price has digested the gap in a tight 4-week range above a rising SMA20, on fading volume, which looks like constructive consolidation. A pullback entry at 119-121 with a stop at 116.7 gives a defined-risk long, and a breakout above 124.62 targets the measured move to 132.1. Weaknesses are honest and material: a risk-off regime, price at the mean analyst target, RSI near overbought, and only about 1.4R to the first resistance. This is a modest, size-limited long, not a high-conviction one.
